def handle_datagram(self,e,ev,t):
    if self.state!='open':
        for p,pkt in enumerate(ev['packets']):
            add_result(e,p,'dropped','CONNECTION_CLOSED',t,None)
        return
    packets=ev['packets']
    if any(pkt['level']=='A' for pkt in packets[:-1]):  # any A not final
        for p in range(len(packets)): add_result dropped LAYOUT t
        return
    size=ev['bytes']
    for p,pkt in enumerate(packets):
        if self.state!='open':
            add_result(e,p,'dropped','CONNECTION_CLOSED',t,None); continue
        self.process_live_packet(e,p,pkt,t,size,drained=False)
